member.name: M:UniversalSso.Client.Config.ProviderPattern
member.remarks:
Pattern:
^[a-z0-9_-]{1,64}$
Explanation:
○ Match if at the beginning of the string.
○ Match a character in the set [-0-9_a-z] atomically at least 1 and at most 64 times.
○ Match if at the end of the string or if before an ending newline.

member.name: T:UniversalSso.Client.GatewayClient
member.summary: HTTP client for the Universal SSO gateway. Contract (see cmd/ssod/handler.go): GET /healthz returns 200 {"status":"ok"}; GET /providers returns 200 {"providers":[...]}; GET /auth/{provider}/login returns 302 to the IdP; GET /auth/{provider}/callback returns 200 {"provider_id","user"}; errors are {"code","message"}. Redirects are never followed automatically so every hop can be checked. Instances are thread-safe.

member.name: T:UniversalSso.Client.Policy
member.summary: Client-side safety policy for the authorization redirect. The gateway owns the signed state, the PKCE verifier and the client secret. This class only checks that the redirect about to be handed to a browser is sane for an OAuth 2.0 / OIDC authorization-code flow (Microsoft Entra ID uses one).

member.name: M:UniversalSso.Client.Policy.CheckAuthorizeUrl(System.Uri,System.Uri,System.String)
member.summary: Verifies and returns the state value it carries. Rules: the scheme is http or https, and https is required unless the redirect stays on the gateway's own host (the mock provider); when is set the host equals it or is a subdomain; state is present; PKCE is used with code_challenge_method=S256.
